parent: Phase-22 showed four individual Fourier sine-mode omissions were each sufficient at 45/45; Phase-23 compact geometry aggregation was CONTROL_FAIL
question: How many of the four individually dispensable sine directions can be removed simultaneously while preserving four-family transfer?

basis.full: fixed real orthonormal 3x3 DFT basis from Phase 22
basis.tested_lattice: exhaustive subsets of the four candidate sine modes of sizes 0,1,2,3,4

identifier.recursive_state_projection: same frozen Phase-10 18-bit companded token representation after every predicted step

paired_design: Within each replicate all 16 Fourier-subset variants share exactly the same representation codebooks, physical trajectories, contexts and targets. Only which subset of the four preregistered sine modes is omitted changes.
control_rule: The full rank-9 no-omission control must pass all 45 registered cells. Otherwise Phase 24 is CONTROL_FAIL and compression sufficiency is not interpreted.
variant_rule: Conditional on control PASS, an omission subset is sufficient only if all 45 registered cells for that exact subset have companded rollout MSE / raw-state persistence MSE < 1.0. Any one failure makes that subset insufficient. No posthoc rotation or replacement.
primary_outcomes: minimum retained Fourier spatial rank among tested sufficient variants
complete set of sufficient omission subsets at each tested rank
whether all four individually dispensable sine modes can be removed jointly
failure_policy: All registered outcomes are retained. No consumed replicate is rerun or replaced. A successful subset cannot erase failures of another subset.
collision_policy: If any 824240xxx seed collides with a previously consumed registered seed before execution, stop before consuming it and preregister a repair namespace only for unconsumed seeds.
claim_limit: Synthetic known-law benchmark only. A sufficient structured subset is conditional on this 3x3 grid representation, tokenizer, context, polynomial center terms, identifier and four-family suite; it is not a universal minimal operator dimension or discovery of new physics.
